topics.topic: DOJ drops investigation into Jerome Powell
topics.description: The Department of Justice has dropped its criminal investigation into Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell, referring the matter to the Inspector General.
topics.reason: DOJ decision on Jerome Powell investigation
